title: Phosphorylation promotes the endonuclease-like activity of human centrin 2.
authors: Yang, Jing; Zhao, Yaqin; Yang, Binsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究磷酸化调控人centrin 2蛋白的核酸内切酶样活性及其与DNA结合，采用分子对接模拟，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作但非典型TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移，故评5分。
abstract: Centrin is a member of the EF-hand superfamily of calcium-binding proteins, which is involved in the nucleotide excision repair (NER). Reversible phosphorylation of centrin is an important regulatory mechanism in vivo and is closely related to many physiological processes. To explore the possible role of centrin in NER, the endonuclease-like activity of human centrin 2 (HsCen2) regulated by phosphorylation in the absence or presence of Tb(3+) was investigated by spectroscopy techniques, gel electrophoresis, and molecular docking simulation in 10 mM Hepes, pH 7.4. The results showed that phosphorylation weakened the binding of Tb(3+) to HsCen2 and enhanced the binding of DNA to HsCen2. Phosphorylation improves the endonuclease-like activity of HsCen2. In addition, Tb(3+) is favorable for DNA binding and endonuclease-like activity of HsCen2 before and after phosphorylation. These results provide clear insights into the effects of phosphorylation on the properties of HsCen2 and offer important clues for further exploration of how phosphorylation affects protein-driven functions.
abstract_zh: Centrin是EF-hand超家族钙结合蛋白的一员，参与核苷酸切除修复（NER）。Centrin的可逆磷酸化是体内重要的调控机制，与许多生理过程密切相关。为探究centrin在NER中的可能作用，在10 mM Hepes（pH 7.4）条件下，通过光谱技术、凝胶电泳和分子动力学模拟，研究了在有无Tb(3+)存在时，磷酸化调控的人centrin 2（HsCen2）的核酸内切酶样活性。结果表明，磷酸化减弱了Tb(3+)与HsCen2的结合，并增强了DNA与HsCen2的结合。磷酸化提高了HsCen2的核酸内切酶样活性。此外，Tb(3+)有利于磷酸化前后HsCen2的DNA结合和核酸内切酶样活性。这些结果清晰揭示了磷酸化对HsCen2性质的影响，并为进一步探索磷酸化如何影响蛋白质驱动功能提供了重要线索。
